answer: Each identity locks a 75-credit bond, claims one meadow-register relic and restores it: cleaning, resetting its prism lens, filing a key-signed facet checklist. An auditor re-inspects the relic against that checklist and the meadow register; mismatch, repeat claim, or wrong key burns the bond. First: 34 credits; kth: 34+7(k-1); 1000th: 7027; 1,000 fakes: 3,530,500 plus 75,000 locked. A rented-restorer ring fails: its checklist carries the renter's key and a prism count matching another relic, so both bonds burn. An honest restorer pays 34 once, recovering the bond after a clean audit.
